title: Penzene drawing (.penz), versions 1 and 2
description: Coordinates are points, x right and y down; a bond is 14.4 points long. Readers ignore fields they don't know, so every object allows extra properties.

v2.description: Version 2 (Penzene 2.0 on): every page in pages, and the document settings all the pages share at the top. A page's own setting overrides the top's.

v1.description: Version 1: one page's drawing, with any other pages (Penzene 1.2 on) in pages; versions before pages open the first page only. The clipboard and exported images carry version 1.

pages.description: The file's other pages, in order: each a version 1 document of its own with its own name.

name.description: The page's name, on its tab ("Page 1" when missing).

style.description: Drawing style name, e.g. "ACS 1996"; unknown names fall back to the default.

hideImplicitH.description: Ignored: older versions could hide implicit hydrogens on labels; they are always shown now.

labelRatio.description: Label font size over bond length, from a ChemDraw file. Absent: the drawing style's own.

showShifts.description: Predicted 13C shifts drawn beside the carbons.

aromaticCircleOverrides.description: Rings (atom indices) drawn the other way from the aromaticCircles setting.

page.description: A page size shown on the canvas, and where its top-left corner sits.

group.description: Atoms, arrows and texts sharing a group number act as one (Arrange → Group).

z.description: Atomic number; 0 for a generic or R-group label.

label.description: Shown instead of the element: an abbreviation (OMe, Boc) or generic label.

isotope.description: Mass number (13 for carbon-13, 2 for deuterium); 0 or left out for natural abundance.

partial.description: Partial charge mark: δ− or δ+.

stereoGroup.description: Enhanced stereo group of a stereocentre: abs (as drawn), &n (a mixture of it and its mirror image) or orn (one of the two, unknown which).

standsFor.description: What a variable label (X, R1) stands for, such as "N, O, S" or "H, Me, OMe"; shown in its molecule's legend, and a query atom list in MOL and SMARTS when every entry is an element.

attachments.description: Variable attachment: this bare point (z 0) stands for a bond to any one of these atoms (indices).

a.description: First atom; a wedge starts here.

position.description: Which side a double bond's second line goes.

arrow.description: Arrows, and the plain lines and shapes (whose points are opposite corners).

kind.description: Orbitals run from their centre (x1, y1) to the tip of their main lobe (x2, y2).

bend.description: Curvature: how far the middle bows out, in points.

look.description: Orbitals: lines only, the main phase filled, or both phases in a soft gradient.

behind.description: Drawn under the molecule rather than over it.

crossed.description: No reaction: an ✕ across the arrow's middle.

head.description: Arrowhead size, relative to the usual.

filled.description: Boxes and ellipses: filled with their colour, as a TLC spot.

plate.description: A box that is a TLC plate: the lowest line across it is the baseline, the highest the solvent front, and each spot on it has its Rf written beside it.

fromAt.description: What the tail is drawn on and follows: one atom, or a bond's two atoms.

toAt.description: What the head is drawn on and follows, as fromAt.

compound.description: A compound number: bold, renumbered in scheme order as the drawing is edited.

legend.description: Its molecule's variable definitions (X = N, O, S), rewritten from the atoms' standsFor as the drawing is edited.

rf.description: A TLC spot's Rf, rewritten beside the spot as the drawing is edited.

anchor.description: The atom of the molecule a compound number or legend belongs to; it moves with the molecule.

round.description: Round brackets; absent or false: square.

label.description: Subscript, e.g. n for a repeat unit.
